generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a tall, narrow conifer with a drooping leader, slender level to drooping branches and feathery, flat sprays of short needles in two ranks; very shade tolerant. Not fitted to measurements. Cones (plant forms F3): 1.5 to 3 cm hang from the shoot tips; set from general knowledge of the species, not measured.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 33 m tall and 45 cm across at breast height at 60 years in a closed stand. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: soft dark green needles with paler undersides; dark reddish-brown furrowed bark.
